name: insightful-phish
description: Insightful Phish is a cybersecurity awareness training platform for phishing simulation, training, interaction tracking, and reporting.

scripts.lint: pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:shared
scripts.docker:tools:install: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.docker:shell: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace sh
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm build
scripts.docker:build:backend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm build:backend
scripts.docker:build:frontend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm build:frontend
scripts.docker:build:shared: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm build:shared
scripts.docker:lint: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm lint
scripts.docker:lint:backend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm lint:backend
scripts.docker:lint:frontend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm lint:frontend
scripts.docker:lint:shared: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm lint:shared
scripts.docker:typecheck: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm typecheck
scripts.docker:typecheck:backend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm typecheck:backend
scripts.docker:typecheck:frontend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm typecheck:frontend
scripts.docker:typecheck:shared: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm typecheck:shared
scripts.docker:test: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test
scripts.docker:test:backend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:backend
scripts.docker:test:frontend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:frontend
scripts.docker:test:shared: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:shared
scripts.docker:test:coverage: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:coverage
scripts.docker:test:coverage:backend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:coverage:backend
scripts.docker:test:coverage:frontend: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:coverage:frontend
scripts.docker:test:coverage:shared: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm test:coverage:shared
scripts.docker:format: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm format
scripts.docker:format:check: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm format:check
scripts.docker:prisma:generate: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend prisma:generate
scripts.docker:prisma:migrate: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.docker:prisma:studio: docker compose --profile tools run --rm --service-ports workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend prisma:studio --port 5555
scripts.docker:seed:demo1: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend seed:demo1
scripts.docker:db:migrate:test: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend prisma:migrate:deploy'
scripts.docker:test:integration:backend: pnpm docker:db:create:test && pnpm docker:db:migrate:test && docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend test:integration
scripts.docker:mailpit:smoke: docker compose --profile tools run --rm workspace pnpm --filter @insightful-phish/backend mailpit:smoke
